description.en: Periodic sweep: open TODOs in saas-factory project, dependency updates, container cleanup
description.de: Regelmäßiger Sweep: offene SaaS-Factory-TODOs, Dependency-Updates, Container-Cleanup

instructions: Wird per Schedule (wöchentlich) ausgeführt. Räumt alte Container auf, listet offene TODOs, triggert Auto-Fix für test-failed-TODOs falls noch nicht gefixt.

config.command:
set -euo pipefail
FACTORY="${FACTORY_ROOT:-/home/flo/Entwicklung/IdeaProjects/saas-factory}"
echo '=== Cleanup alter Container/Images (>14 Tage) ==='
"$FACTORY/tools/factory" cleanup --older-than 14 || true

set -euo pipefail
DB='/home/flo/Entwicklung/tools/autotrigger/ai-automation-backend/data/automation.db'
KEY=$(python3 -c "import sqlite3; c=sqlite3.connect('$DB'); print(c.execute(\"SELECT value FROM app_settings WHERE key='api-key'\").fetchone()[0])")
echo '=== Offene SaaS-Factory-TODOs ==='
curl -s 'http://localhost:9090/api/v1/todos?status=OPEN&projectId=685061f8-5eb6-4f9e-9bf7-2b1549325eee&size=100' -H "X-API-Key: $KEY" | python3 -c 'import sys,json;d=json.load(sys.stdin);content=d.get("content",d) if isinstance(d,dict) else d;print(f"OPEN_COUNT={len(content)}");[print(f"- [{t[\"priority\"]}] {t[\"id\"][:8]} {t[\"title\"]}") for t in content[:20]]'

Du hast den Output von Block 1 (cleanup) und Block 2 (offene TODOs).
